digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation sign failure classification
propositions: When attestation write fails with lock timeout and sidecar_emitted is false, sign-review recovery guidance is advertised but cannot work because no PASS record persisted
classify_plan_review_attestation catch-all branch reaches for lock-timeout failures without inspecting sidecar_emitted field, misclassifying sidecar-lost cases as signable failures
Failed-sign results with sidecar_emitted=False must classify as ATTESTATION_SIDECAR_LOST with recovery_tool=review_plan, not ATTESTATION_SIGN_FAILED with recovery_tool=sign_review
The recorded verdict remains from the previous round when sidecar is lost, creating a stale contradicting verdict that is not current
